extracted.intended_audience: researchers, historians, librarians, and general public seeking digitized historical Associated Press clippings and microfilm metadata
extracted.subtask_short: archive item metadata for news clippings
extracted.subtask_description: A catalog/metadata page for a digitized microfilm issue of Associated Press clippings (Europe Disorders, 1961-08-13) that provides bibliographic metadata, OCR details, download options, and collection context. The page is intended to help users discover and download the digitized item.
